title: Regional Director Operations-RD
text:
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership, client partnership support, and strategic oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts within an assigned region. This position partners closely with community leadership teams, culinary operations, resident experience teams, and corporate leadership to ensure operational excellence, financial performance, hospitality culture, regulatory compliance, and elevated resident satisfaction across all assigned communities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is an exempt salaried position, with expected hours to include: days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Functions and Duties

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and operational oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts
* Support and mentor Directors of Dining Services, Executive Chefs, Resident Experience leaders, and community management teams
* Ensure operational consistency, hospitality standards, and service excellence throughout all assigned communities
* Conduct regular operational visits, audits, and performance reviews

Client & Resident Relationships

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client leadership teams, residents, families, and operational partners
* Ensure resident satisfaction initiatives and hospitality-focused service culture remain a top operational priority
* Participate in client meetings, operational reviews, and strategic planning discussions
* Address operational concerns and support service recovery initiatives when needed

Financial Management

* Manage regional financial performance including:

* labor management,
* food cost controls,
* budgeting,
* forecasting,
* and overall account profitability

* Analyze financial reports and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement
* Support implementation of operational efficiencies and cost-control initiatives

Culinary & Hospitality Excellence

* Support culinary innovation, menu development, dining presentation, and hospitality-driven service initiatives
* Ensure dining environments reflect company hospitality standards and resident experience expectations
* Promote elevated dining experiences throughout all communities

Associate Leadership & Development

* Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop operational leadership teams
* Support associate engagement, retention, succession planning, and performance management initiatives
* Foster a positive, professional, and accountability-driven culture throughout the region
* Assist with onboarding and transition support for new business and leadership changes

Compliance & Quality Assurance

* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local, and company regulations and standards
* Support sanitation, food safety, healthcare compliance, and regulatory audit readiness
* Conduct operational assessments and quality assurance reviews
* Ensure corrective action plans are implemented and maintained when necessary

Travel

This role will be 80-100% travel. Travel will be by car and/or plane and will include overnight travel.

General Responsibility as Required for Position

The Regional Director of Operations serves as the primary operational leader supporting community-level Directors, Executive Chefs, and management teams while helping drive consistency, service excellence, associate engagement, and overall client satisfaction throughout the region. This role requires strong leadership presence, hospitality mindse, financial acumen, and the ability to build strong operational partnerships within senior living environments

AAP/EEO Statement

Forefront will not discriminate based on race, color, sex, height, weight, disability, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, military service, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or any other protected class in its hiring practices, conditions for transfer or promotion, policies, discipline, discharge, terms, conditions or benefits of employment.

Other Duties as assigned

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Job duties, tasks, responsibilities, and activities may change from time to time.

Requirements:

Education/Experience/Training

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Hospitality Management, Culinary Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field
* 5+ years of progressive multi-site operational leadership experience
* Senior living, healthcare dining, hospitality, or foodservice management experience strongly preferred
* Strong financial management and operational analysis experience
* Experience leading large operational teams across multiple locations
* Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship management skills
* Strong problem-solving and organizational abilities
* Ability to travel extensively throughout assigned region

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Senior living dining and hospitality experience
* Multi-unit healthcare or hospitality operational leadership experience
* Culinary operations and resident experience knowledge
* Experience with client relationship management and contract dining operations
* ServSafe Certification preferred
